tei:div.tei:p: (tsa)༄༅// chos kyi dbang phyug gis dris pa'i mngon pa'i dri lan bzhugs so// na mo lo ki shwa ra ya/ srid zhi'i dbang phyug dbyig gi snying po yang*// bshes gnyen ji bzhin gang blo'i rjes song bas// mkhas pa'i gnas thob grags pa'i khrir 'khod pa// 'dzam gling rgyan gcig deng 'dir phyag gi 'os// mang du sems pa'i nags khrod nyams dga' bar// lang tsho yol kyang legs bshad tshol bya'i phyir// snying nas bsam pa dag pas 'dri gang khyed// chos mngon shes bya'i khyams chen 'dir spyon la// gzhan dang mi mnyam rnam dpyod lag pa yis// blo gros shel gyi ngos 'jam la bris pa'i// yid 'ongs legs bshad gtam 'di long mdzod dang*// mkhas pa'i gral 'gor bzhugs la snyems mi 'tshal// gang yang 'di skad du/ chos mngon pa 'og ma nas 'byung ba'i chos shes dang rjes shes kyi khyad pa gang la byed/ mi lcogs med la brten pa'i rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi grangs dang*/ de'i nges pa ni ci/ mthong spang dang sgom spang spong tshul mi 'dra bar bshad na de la khyad par ci yod/ mthong spang nyid la yang spong tshul mi 'dra ba gsum bshad pa de'i don gang yin/ zhes 'dri bar snang ngo*// de'i lan la bzhi las/ dri ba dang po'i lan ni/ gnyen po'i khyad par 'dod pa khams kyi dbang du byas pa'i bden pa la dmigs nas dang pos shes pa dang*/ khams gong ma'i dbang du byas pa'i bden pa la dmigs nas rjes su shes pa la bya zhing*/ chos shes ni lus rten 'dod pa dang*/ sems rten sa drug po kho nar nges pa yin te/ ji skad du/ chos shes pa yi spyod yul ni// 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal la sogs yin// rjes su shes pa'i spyod yul ni// gong ma'i sdug bsngal la sogs pa// zhes dang*/ chos shes bya ba 'dod rten can// zhes dang*/ drug na chos shes bya zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro// de la'ang mthong sgom gyi dbye bas gnyis gnyis su yod cing*/

dang po mthong lam shes pa gnyis ni/ rnam par grol ba'i lam kho nar nges shing*/ sgom pa'i lam gyi shes pa gnyis la ni/ lam bzhi'i dbye bas bzhi bzhir 'gyur ba yin no// de las gzhan du/ bsam gtan dang po nas srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar gyi bden pa la ni dmigs pa'i chos shes bzhi bzhi yod par rang 'grel las bshad do// zhes zer ba de la ni/ khungs yod pa ma yin no// gal te yod na ston shig dang spyi bos nod par bgyi'o// dri ba gnyis pa'i lan la/ ngo bo ngos bzung nas rnam pa'i grangs kyi dbye ba bshad pa dang*/ der nges pa'i rgyu mtshan no// dang po ni/ 'dir rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin zhes pa/ srid rtse'i sas bsdus pa'i sgom spang gi thob pa gcod par byed pa'i bar chad med lam zhig yin la/ de la bzod pa ni mi srid pas shes pa kho nar nges so// de la'ang drug te/ bden pa bzhi shes pa dang*/ chos shes dang rjes shes so// de skad du/ bar chad med pa'i lam la drug /de bzhin srid rtse'i rnam rgyal la'ang*// zhes so// de dag kyang bsdu na gnyis su 'dus pas/ dang po chos shes la 'gog lam gyi dbye bas gnyis kho na yin zhing*/ de re re la yang rnam pa'i dbye bas bzhi bzhi ste brgyad do// gnyis pa rjes shes la yang gnyis te/ dang po ni/ srid pa'i rtse mo'i sas bsdus pa'i sdug kun la dmigs pa'i rjes shes gnyis kho nar nges shing*/ de re re la yang rnam pa'i dbye bas bzhi bzhi ste brgyad do// gnyis pa la/ 'gog pa la dang*/ lam la rjes shes gnyis so// dang po ni/ spyir khams gong gi spang bya spangs pa'i 'gog pa la dmigs pa'i shes pa gcig yin la/ de la'ang spang bya'i rten sa brgyad kyi dbye bas grangs brgyad kho na yin la/ de re re la yang rnam pa'i dbye bas bzhi bzhi ste sum cu rtsa gnyis so// gnyis pa lam la rjes shes ni/ spyir khams gong gi gnyen por gyur pa'i lam dang*/

bye brag tu chos shes ma yin pa'i lam bden pa la dmigs pa'i shes pa gcig yin la/ de la ming gi sgo nas dbye na/ spang bya'i rten sa brgyad du dbye rung yang*/ 'dir don gyi sgo nas brgyad po de thams cad gcig tu bgrang ngo*// gcig pu de la'ang rnam pa'i dbye ba bzhi kho na ste/ de ltar na lnga bcu rtsa gnyis so// 'dir rnam pa'i dbye bas bzhi bzhir bshad pa ni/ ji skad du/ chos shes pa dang rjes su shes// rnam pa bcu drug ces dang rang bden rnam pa can// zhes bshad pa de nyid yin no// gnyis pa grangs nges pa'i rgyu mtshan la/ chos shes kyi nges pa dang*/ rjes shes kyi nges pa'o// dang po la/ grangs nges kyi rgyu mtshan dang*/ khams gong gi gnyen po yin pa'i rgyu mtshan no// dang po ni/ 'dir chos shes kyi dbye ba brgyad kho nar 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'di'i chos shes kyi 'dod pa'i gnyen por gyur pa'i 'gog lam kho na la dmigs pa yin gyi/ gzhan med pas so// gnyis pa la/ lung dang*/ rigs pa'o// dang po ni/ sgom pa'i lam la 'gog pa'am// lam la chos shes gang yin te// khams gsum gyi ni gnyen po yin// zhes gsungs pas so// gnyis pa ni/ de gnyis der bzhag nas sdug kun la chos shes gnyis gong ma'i gnyen por mi 'jog pa yang*/ snga ma gnyis kyi dmigs pa ni zag med kho na yin zhing de'i dmigs par gyur pa'i zag med de khams gsum ka'i gnyen por rung ba dang*/ phyi ma gnyis kyis ni 'dod pa'i sas bsdus pa'i sdug kun kho na la dmigs shing*/ de gnyis/ gong ma'i gnyen por mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin no// 'o na lam chos shes kyi dmigs par gyur pa'i lam de gang yin/ des de shes pa'i tshul ji lta bu/ de ltar shes pa de khams gong gi gnyen por rung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ lan la gnyis te/ dngos dang*/ des 'gog pa chos shes kyang mtshon pa'o// dang po la/ 'dir lan ni/

mi rtag la sogs bcu drug mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgom lam zhig yin la/ de khams gsum gyi gnyen po so sor byed pa'i cha nas 'dod pa'i lam bden dang*/ khams gong ma'i lam bden zhes ming so sor btags so// de shes pa'i tshul ni/ lam rigs pa sgrub pa/ nges 'byin gyi tshul gyis shes pa'o// de yang lam ngo bo gcig po de nyid 'dod pa'i gnyen po byed pa'i cha nas lam sogs kyi mtshan nyid can du shes pa la chos shes pa dang*/ gong ma'i gnyen po byed pa'i cha nas/ de'i mtshan nyid can du shes pa la rjes shes zhes bya bar ming btags pa yin no// de gong ma'i gnyen por rung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ lam la chos shes dang*/ rjes shes gnyis ming so sor btags pa yin gyi/ don ni rnam pa bcu drug mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgom lam gcig nyid lam sogs kyi mtshan nyid du shes pa kho na yin gyi/ de las rdzas gzhan med pas so// de'i phyir sdug kun la chos shes rjes gnyis dang 'di mi 'dra'o// 'o na lam la rjes shes kyang 'dod pa'i gnyen por 'gyur te/ rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir ro snyam na/ ma yin te/ sgom pa'i lam rjes shes skyes pa de'i tshe/ 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang bral zin pa'i phyir/ ji skad du/ 'dod pa'i khams gyi rjes ma yin zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ 'gog pa la chos shes pa'i tshul/ de gong ma'i gnyen por rung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de nyid kyis grub pa yin no// 'di la dogs pa gnyis 'byung ste/ gnyen po mthong lam la mtshungs pa dang*/ spang bya nyon mongs pa la mtshungs pa spang ba'o// dang po ni/ lam la chos bzod kyis kyang gong ma'i mthong spang spong nus par 'gyur te/ rgyu mtshan khyed rang gis bshad pa de nyid kyi phyir snyam na/ mtshungs pa ma yin te/ khams gsum gyi gnyen po lam bden gyi mtshan nyid lan gcig mngon sum du mthong zin pa'i rjes thogs su 'dod pa'i gnyen po lam gyi mtshan nyid shes nas goms pa dang*/

khams gong gi gnyen po lam bden gyi mtshan nyid shes nas goms pa gnyis ming dang ldog pas phye ba ma gtogs don gcig la 'du bas/ gong du bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan mi 'khrul la/ sngar ma mthong sar mthong la ni 'dod pa'i gnyen po lam bden gyi mtshan nyid mngon sum du mthong yang*/ gong ma'i gnyen po lam bden gyi mtshan nyid mngon sum du ma mthong ba srid pa'i phyir ro// ji skad du/ ma mthong mthong phyir mthong ba'i lam// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ 'o na sgom lam chos shes kyis ngos skal gyi spang bya spangs pa na/ rjes shes kyi yang de spangs pa 'gyur te/ dam bca' de nyid kyi phyir ro snyam na/ lan la rnam grangs gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lam chos shes kyi ming can gyi sgom lam gcig po de nyid/ khams gong gi gnyen por sgoms nas yid la byed pa de'i tshe/ rjes shes su mi 'pho ba yin pas mi 'gal lo// rnam grangs gnyis pa ni/ yang na 'dod par nus pa ma yin te/ sgom lam rjes shes kyi spang bya gang yin de nyid chos shes kyi yang yin pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa rjes shes kyi nges pa la/ sdug kun la rjes shes kyi dang*/ 'gog lam la rjes shes kyi nges pa bsam pa'o// dang po ni/ ci yang med man chad kyi sdug kun la rjes shes 'dir bgrangs pa ma yin te/ des srid rtse'i sas bsdus kyi phung po la ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ 'gog pa la rjes shes kyi nges pa bsam pa dang*/ lam la rjes shes kyi nges pa bsam pa'o// dang po ni/ srid rtse'i gnyen por gyur pa'i 'gog pa rjes shes rnams ni/ sa brgyad kyi dbye bas brgyad du bgrang dgos pa yin te/ bsam gtan dang po'i 'gog pa la dmigs pa'i rjes shes kyis sa gzhan gyi 'gog pa la ma dmigs pa sogs dmigs yul so sor nges pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang*/ rang gi sa pa'i 'gog pa ni// spyod yul can gyi yul yin no// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/

srid rtse'i gnyen por gyur pa'i lam la rjes shes ni ming brgyad yod kyang*/ don gcig tu bgrangs pas chog pa yin te/ bsam gtan dang po'i gnyen po lam la rjes shes des/ sa brgyad ka'i gnyen por gyur pa'i lam bden la dmigs pa sogs re re nas dmigs rnam mtshungs pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang*/ lam ni phan tshun rgyu yin pas// sa drug sa dgu'i lam ni de'i// spyod yul can gyi yul yin no// zhes so// 'dir chos rjes phan tshun blo phyogs phyir// zhes pa'i don la bsams nas zhib cha cung zad 'don no// 'o na bsam gtan dang po'i 'gog pa rkyang pa la dmigs pa'i rjes shes kyis srid rtse'i 'gog pa rjes shes kyi spangs bya ji ltar spong nus she na/ de nus pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bsam gtan dang po'i 'gog pa thob byed kyi zag med mi lcogs med pa de nyid srid rtse'i 'gog pa thob byed kyi skal mnyam gyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ ji skad du/ sa dgu'i lam ni phan tshun du// mnyam dang khyad par can gyi yin// zhes so// dri ba gsum pa'i lan la/ don gyi khog phub pa dang*/ dngos kyi lan 'don pa'o// dang po ni/ 'dir spang bya gnyis kyi spong tshul bstan pa de spyi tsam nas bstan pa ma yin gyi/ 'o na ci zhe na/ spangs pa'i 'bras bu yongs shes kyi 'jog mtshams shes pa'i phyir du yin te/ ji ltar zhe na/ mthong spang spangs pa'i yongs shes drug la ni/ zag med bar chad med lam gyis spangs pa nges par dgos te/ ji skad du/ drug bzod 'bras/ shes bshad pa'o// sgom spang spangs pa'i yongs shes 'jog pa la ni/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis spangs pas chog pa yang yod de/ ji skad du/ 'jig rten pa'i gnyis/ shes bshad pas so// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar grub pa na/ yongs shes 'jog pa'i dus kyi mthong spangs rnams ni/ gnyen po skyes pa tsam gyis spong ba ma yin te/ gnyen po zhi rags kyi rnam pa can gyis mthong spang spangs pa tsam la yongs shes 'jog par mi nus pa'i phyir/

yongs shes 'jog pa'i dus kyi sgom spang la ni gnyen po zhi rags kyi rnam pa can gyis nyams par 'jog nus pa yin te/ 'phags pas 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis 'dod pa dang gzugs la chags bral byas pa'i tshe/ tha ma'i cha mthun spangs pa'i yongs shes dang*/ gzugs kyi zag pa zad pa'i yongs shes gnyis 'jog pa'i phyir 'di la bral thob zag med ji ltar yod ce na/ ji skad du/ 'jig rten pa yi chags bral ba'i// 'phags la bral ba'i thob rnam gnyis// shes bshad pas so zhes so// dri ba bzhi pa'i lan la/ don gyi khog phub pa dang*/ spong tshul gsum so sor shes pa'o// dang po ni/ mthong bas spang bar bya ba rnams ni rigs gnyis su bsdus te/ sdug kun dang*/ 'gog lam mthong spang ngo*// dang po la gnyis te rang sa la dmigs pa dang*/ gong sa la dmigs pa'o// gnyis po 'gal ba ni ma yin te/ sdug kun mthong spang gong sa la dmigs pa rnams ni/ khams kun 'gro yin pas rang sa la dmigs dgos pa'i phyir ro// dang po rang sa la dmigs pa la gnyis te/ kun 'gro yin pa dang*/ ma yin pa'o// dang po ni/ mthong spang nyon mongs spyi mtshan pa rnams so// gnyis pa ni/ de rang mtshan pa rnams so// gnyis pa 'gog lam mthong spang la gnyis te/ dang po ni/ der gyur pa'i nyon mongs spyi mtshan pa rnams so// gnyis pa ni/ de rang mtshan pa rnams so// de ltar bzhi las/ sdug kun mthong spang la ni spangs pa tsam gyis de spang pa'i yongs shes bzhag nus pa ma yin te/ de gnyis kyi khyad par 'ga' zhig la spangs kyang ma bral ba srid pa'i phyir/ de skad du/ sdug bsngal mthong spang bya spangs kyang*// kun 'gro lhag ma rnams kyis ldan// zhes bshad pas so// sgom spang la yang cir de ltar yod mod/ tha ma'i cha mthun dang*/ gzugs kyi zag pa dang*/ gzugs med kyi zag pa rnams la ni spangs na bral bas khyab pa yin no// de bzhin du 'gog lam mthong spang gi rigs gnyis po gang yin kyang*/

spangs na bral bas khyab pa yin te/ de dang de dag la phra rgyas kun 'gro'i rnam gzhag ma mdzad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dngos lan so sor bstan pa la/ spyir mthong spang thams cad dmigs pa bden pa bzhi'i mtshan nyid shes nas spong dgos pa la khyad par med kyang*/ 'dir spong tshul mi 'dra ba gsum bshad pa de ni dngos kyi dmigs pa'i dbang du byas pa yin no// 'o na dngos kyi dmigs pa ma shes par spong ba ji ltar yod ce na/ sdug kun mthong spang gong sa la dmigs pa rnams so// de yang ci zhe na/ 'dod pa'i sdug kun chos bzod kyi khams gong ma la dngos su ma dmigs pa'o// gal te dmigs na/ de rjes bzod du thal bas so// yang dngos kyi dmigs pa shes tsam gyis spong mi nus pa yang yod de/ 'gog lam mthong spang zag bcas la dmigs pa rnams so// de yang ji ltar zhe na/ de'i dmigs pa zag bcas ni/ sdug kun bzod pa gnyis kyis kyang shes pa'i phyir te/ 'di nyid kyis mi shes pa'i zag bcas mi srid pa'i phyir/ de ltar na dngos kyi dmigs pa yongs su shes pas spong ba ni/ sdug kun mthong spang rang sa la dmigs pa dang*/ 'gog lam mthong spang zag med la dmigs pa rnams so// de la dmigs pa yang dag par zad pas spong ba ni/ sdug kun mthong spang gong sa la dmigs pa rnams so// 'o na sdug kun mthong spang gong sa la dmigs pa dgu po de yang*/ dngos kyi dmigs pa yongs su shes pa tsam gyis spong nus par 'gyur te/ de dag kyang rang la dmigs pa'i phra rgyas kun 'gro yin pa'i phyir/ gal te 'dod na ni/ de la dmigs pa yang dag par zad pas spong*/ zhes spong tshul gnyis pa bshad pa la don med do snyam na thal ba snga ma la 'dod na/ phyi ma la khyab pa ma nges pa yin te/ phra rgyas kun 'gro gong sa la dmigs pa dgu po de dngos kyi dmigs pa 'dod pa'i sdug kun gnyis kyi mtshan nyid mngon sum du shes pa tsam gyis spangs kyang*/

dgu po rang nyid la dmigs pa'i kun 'gro gzhan rnams ma spangs kyi bar du ma bral zhing ldan pas spangs pa dang bral ba gnyis tshogs de bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir du spong tshul gnyis pa de bshad pa yin no// de las cir 'gyur zhe na/ ji skad du/ bral ba'i thob pa zag med dang*// rgyu gnyis kun tu bcom pa'i phyir// yongs shes/ shes pa de sgrub pa'i don du'o// 'dir de la dmigs pa zhes pa ni/ 'dod pa'i log lta lta bu de la/ dmigs pa'i spang bya rigs lnga po rnams la bya ba yin no// gsum pa 'gog lam mthong spang zag bcas la dmigs pa rnams dmigs pa yongs su zad pas spong ba'i tshul ni/ dper na 'gog lam mthong spang du gyur pa'i lta ba la der gyur pa'i 'dod chags kyis dngos su dmigs pa'i tshe lta bu'o// mdor na dngos su dmigs byed kyi kun 'gro zad pa dang*/ dngos kyi dmigs pa zag bcas zad pa spong ba gnyis ka yang*/ mthar dmigs pa bden pa bzhi'i mtshan nyid yongs su shes pa la rag las so// de ltar dri ba'i lan rnams ni/ lan gsum dpyad cing gzigs gyur na// legs bshad gsar pa'i dbyig rnams ni// khyed blo'i bang mdzod gnyen du 'char// sngon chad mkhas pa mang po la// dris kyang lan ma byung ngo skad// da dung mkhas slob so so la// legs par dris na mkhas pa dang*// mkhas pa min pa'i khyad par gyi// zhal gyi gzugs brnyan gsal po ni// g.yo sgyu'i phag tu mi gab par// mngon sum nyid du ston par 'gyur// zhes sde snod 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi dbang phyug gis dris pa'i mchid lan du/ yul dbus kyi chos mngon pa ba/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos/ mdzad mthong smon gyi gtsug lag khang nas mgyogs par phul ba yin no// 'di yi phyi mo 'di med na// de ru bris la de nas kyang*// mang la phan phyir mang po dag /bris nas phyogs brgyar bris nas bskur//

//maṅga laṃ// ༈ //tshul gnyis rnam 'byed las 'phros pa'i dris lan/ ༄// na mo buddhā ya/ rnal 'byor spyod pa sems tsam pa'i// grub mtha'i ngos 'dzin sngon rabs dang*// phyi rabs 'dod pa mthun nam zhes// dris pa'i lan 'ga' 'dir brjod bya// rnal 'byor spyod pa'i gzhung lugs su// sems tsam pa dang dbu ma pa// gnyis su dbye ba byams pa'i gzhung*// 'grel par bcas pa dag na bzhugs// bod du grags pa sems tsam pa// rnam bden rnam rdzun zhes byar 'chad// sems tsam rnam rdzun yin gyur kyang*// grub mtha'i rtse mor 'chad pa'ang byung*// rnam rdzun lta ba bla med kyi// rgyud dang mthun par 'chad de bzhin// thal rang gzhung gi rjes 'brang ba'i// phar phyin pa rnams rnam rdzun pa// grub mtha' 'og mar 'dod ces pa'ang*// snga rabs pa la byung tshul lo// phyi dus rje btsun red mda' pas// sems tsam rnam rdzun zhes bya ba'i// grub mtha' bod na grags pa de// sangs rgyas pa yi grub mtha' bzhi// gang gi nang na'ang yod ma yin// ci phyir zhe na dbu ma pa// min te bden grub khas blangs phyir// sems tsam min te gzhan gyi dbang*// sgyu ma lta bur 'dod phyir ro// rnal 'byor spyod dang rnam rig pa// sems tsam gsum po don gcig cing*// de yi grub mtha' gzhan dbang dang*// yongs grub gnyis ka bden par grub// kun btags gcig pu bden par med// gzhi dus kun gzhi'i rnam shes dang*// lam dus gang snang sems zhes dang*// 'bras dus gnas gyur khas len pa// gzhung lugs gang na snang gyur kyang*// sems tsam grub mthar gnas zhes gsung*// grub mtha'i rnam dbye mi 'byed pa// thams cad 'di yi rjes su 'brang*// de lta na ni rnam rig pa'i// gzhung na gzung 'dzin gnyis ka yang*// rang gi ngo bos stong par bshad// sems tsam pas kyang der 'dod 'gyur// rnam rig gzhung na stong pa nyid// bcu drug dang ni nyi shu yi// ngos 'dzin 'khrul pa med par bshad// sems tsam pas kyang de 'dod 'gyur// rnam rig gzhung na chags sogs las// nges 'byung chags sogs nyid yin zhes// rnal 'byor bla med gzhung bzhin bshad// sems tsam pas kyang de 'dod 'gyur// rnam rig gzhung na chos dbyings las// ma gtogs shes bya med pa dang*// sems kyang med pa yin zhes bshad// sems tsam pas kyang de 'dod 'gyur// gzung med 'dzin pa med pa dang*// gcig dang du bral gtan tshigs kyis// mthar thug snang ba sems kyang bkag

/sems tsam pas kyang de 'dod 'gyur// rnal 'byor spyod gzhung rgya mtsho na// lam lnga dang ni sa bcu dang*// shes sgrib gnyen po yongs rdzogs bshad// sems tsam pas kyang de 'dod 'gyur// de ltar 'dod mod de dag ni// sgra ji bzhin pa min no zhes// 'chad pa de yis byams pa'i gzhung*// bla med rgyud dang bcas pa spangs// sems tsam pa la stong pa nyid// bcu drug rnam gzhag yod ces zer// gzung 'dzin gnyis kyis mi stong pa// de srid stong nyid bcu drug gi /rnam gzhag 'chad nus min pa ni// thogs med mched kyi srol las 'byung*// sems tsam pa yi lta ba yis// rang sangs rgyas las gong mi 'gro// de la stong nyid rtogs blo med// 'dzin pa bden med khas len pa'i// lta ba dbu ma pa yin zhes// rje btsun sku mched rnam gnyis bzhed// khyad par rje btsun red mda' pas// rgyud gsum dgongs pa sems tsam du// gnas pa'i shes byed gang bkod pa// de la gsang ba 'dus pa yi// rgyud kyis ma nges pa de 'phangs// rnam rig pa dang sems tsam pa// don gcig gyur na stong nyid dang*// sa bcu la sogs gang bshad pa// de dag dngos por smra ba dang*// rang sangs rgyas kyi lam du 'gyur// zhes sogs de ltar 'phen pa yin// rgyas par gzhung chen mang po la// bshes gnyen mkhas pa bsnyen byas nas// thos bsam gyis ni sgro 'dogs chod// de nas rgyal ba dges par 'gyur// zhes pa 'di ni bshes gnyen 'gas// tshul gnyis rnam par 'byed gzhung na// rnam rig pa dang dbu ma pa'i// gzhi mthun srid pa ji ltar zhes// dris pa'i lan du gser mdog can// sde snod klog pa'i grwa nas so// //slar yang dris pa ni/ 'o na rnam rig sems tsam la// khyad par ci zhig yod ces dang*// rgyud gsum dgongs pa rnam rig tu// gnas zhes zer mkhan byung ba la// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi stong nyid kyi// gdul bya log pa'i lam dag tu// drangs par thal zhes 'phangs pa de'i// khyab 'brel ji ltar grub pa yin// zhes ni kha cig 'dri bar byed// dri ba dang po'i dngos lan ni// kun rdzob snang tshul ji snyed pa// sems tsam kho na nyid yin zhing*// sems de rdzas su grub ces pa// de la sems tsam pa zhes zer// gzung 'dzin gnyis ka dngos med cing*// don dam ngo bo gnyis stong pa// de yi ngo bo'ang rnam rig ces// 'chad pa de yang rnam rig pa// de phyir rnam rig pa la ni// sems tsam pa yis ma khyab cing*// sems tsam pa la rnam rig dang*// rnal 'byor spyod pas khyab ces pa// gzhung dang sngon gyi rgan po'i lugs// legs ldan 'byed dang zla grags kyi// gzhung gi cha 'ga' la brten nas// rnam rig pa dang sems tsam pa// don gcig zer ba bod yul gyi// deng sang phyi rabs phal cher 'dod// dri ba gnyis pa'i lan btab pa// dbus mtha'i dgongs pa sems tsam du// gnas na rje btsun byams pa yis// stong pa nyid kyi gdul bya rnams// phyin ci log tu drangs par thal// ci phyir zhe na mdo sems dang*// bye brag smra dang gzhan sde la// stong nyid grangs tshang smos ci dgos// nang stong nyid kyi rnam gzhag kyang*// tshang bar yod pa min phyir ro// de dang 'dra bar sems tsam dang*// rnam rig smra ba don gcig tu// byas nas rgyud gsum sems tsam du// gnas par 'dod la thal ba de// 'phangs pa gnod byed nyid du 'jug

/dus 'khor la yang mtshungs mod kyi// phyogs snga ma la ma grub pas// rgyud gsum po dang gsang 'dus kyi// lta ba khyad par med do zhes// rang res legs par bsgrubs pa yin// //swasti/ dbus smyon rdo rje bdud 'dul ni// mar smyon chos blo'i yang tsha yin// 'jigs med paṇa chung legs pa'i blo// paṇa chen kun dang cis mi mnyam// dben par dben gsum yun ring pos// dbu mar tshud pa'i rlung sems kyis// lam du bcug pa'i kun rdzob dang*// don dam byang chub sems zung gis// mtshan 'dzin dbyings su zhi ba dang*// 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku thob mdzod// 'di na la la'i ngo bsrung gis// cung zad rnam par g.yengs byung kyang*// shes rab snying po'i bzlas brjod kyis// lha bu'i bdud las rnam par rgyal// zhes pa'i mtshon byed ja thums la// phyag rgya chen pos rgyas btab bo// //rtogs ldan dbus smyon rdo rje yis// bdud 'dul chen po sku khams bzang*// seng ge bzhin du 'jigs med par// 'gro don yangs pa'i nam mkha' la// nyi ma bzhin du rgyu'o zhes// mchid shog snyan grags 'od dkar can// spros med chos dbyings zhing khams su// zhen med gling bzhi ri rab can// 'dzin med sgyu ma'i ja sig sogs// thogs med nyid du 'dir phebs pas// gang yod bdog pa btang ngo zhes// 'dir yod kun gyis yi rang mdzad// don yod sku tshe ring ba dang*// 'byor yod kun dang mjal bar shog /ces pa'i mtshon byed 'chi med kyi// dbang po'i rdo rje gnyug ma yi// sems kyi rdo rje 'dzin med kyi// phyag rgya che dang mi 'bral ba'i// rten cing 'brel 'byung 'di 'bul na// mig gnyis nyi zla ltar gsal ba'i// klog pa pa yang ri rab ltar// dbang chen gzhi la zhabs brtan pa'i// gdan bzhugs 'byung ba rim brtseg kyang*// yang dang yang du sbyin 'tshal lo// zhes pa 'di yang gser mdog can// sde snod klog pa'i chos grwa nas// mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes bcu la// dge bar phul ba 'di bde'o// rtogs ldan dbus smyon chen po yis// dge bshes kun dga' sangs rgyas la// gdams ngag zab mo sna 'ga' zhig

/yod pa'i chos kyi 'brel pa stsol// yang sngon tshe lha chen ri khrod mar// bcas pas 'khor lo bde mchog tu// sprul zhing rdzus nas 'gro mang la// 'tshe bar gyur pa mang zhes grags// phyi ma'i dus su rgyal ba nyid// rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bcas pa'i// rtag tu zhi ba nyid sprul nas// rnam par rtog pa kun spangs pa'i// bde chen tsakra saṃ bha ra// zhes pa 'di ni mchid shog gi /rten yin ja thums rgya 'byar yang*// hor zla gnyis pa'i bco brgyad la'o// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //dge slong chos dpal bzang po'i zhu lan// ༄// rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal te// rting khebs chos kyis mtsho chen nas// rje btsun chos la dad thob pa// dge slong chos dpal bzang po yis// byang chub phyogs mthun chos kyi ni// go rim lam 'bras gzhung bshad nas// byung dang bdag med bstod 'grel du// bshad pa ma mthun ci zhes gsung*// de lan mdor bsdus 'di bsam bya// phar phyin theg pa'i byang phyogs dang*// sngags kyi byang phyogs ming mthun yang*// don dang go rim mtha' gcig tu// mthun pa med tshul gzhan du bshad// 'dir ni dri ma med rgyan las// gang bshad 'khor lo bde mchog gi /bskyed rim lha mo byang phyogs dang*// sbyor tshul ji bzhin pa de gsungs// der ni byang phyogs sa bcu dang*// mi slob lam dang sbyor mdzad kyi// 'jig rten lam dang mi sbyor zhing*// lung gi sgo bstun yang mi 'chad// lam 'bras chos su phar phyin gyi// lung dang sgo bstun dgos pa'i dbang*// mdzad nas byang phyogs dang po gsum// 'khor lo 'cham pa'i lam dang sbyar// gsum po de yang bskyed rim gyi// byang chub phyogs dang mi mthun na// pha rol phyin pa'i byang phyogs dang*// mthun par mi 'chad smos ci dgos// snang ba dgrar langs zhes bya ba// phyi nang rtag pa'i mtha' la zer// de'i gnyen por nang gi ni// ting 'dzin rdzu 'phrul rkang pa sgom// stong pa dgrar langs zhes bya ba// nang du chad pa'i mthar 'gro ba// de'i gnyen por phyi rol du// lha sogs sgyu mar dran pa sgom// de 'dra'i zhi lhag gnyis po la// rtog pa'i dri mas sbags gyur na// de spong ba ni zung 'jug go

/gzhan yang bum dbang sa drug dang*// byang chub yan lag bdun sbyor zhing*// dbang po lnga dang stobs lnga dang*// 'phags lam yan lag dbang gsum po'i// sa rnams dag dang sbyor mdzad pa// pha rol phyin dang gsang sngags kyi// gzhung gzhan dag tu ma grags kyang*// rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po yi// man ngag nyid kyis bshad pa ste// 'di nas bshad pa'i sa dang ni// lam gyi rnam gzhag ji rnyed pa// gzhan la gsang bar des gsungs so// de ltar 'dri po'i lhag bsam dang*// de lan btab pa'i rnam dkar gyis// rje btsun bla ma'i gsung rabs la// thos bsam sgom pa lhur len shog/ //shrī/ bshes gnyen dge 'dun dpal bzang gi /gsung shog rten bcas mang du phebs// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rim pa gnyis// nyams len gnad 'ga' springs shes pa// nges pa'i don du chos kyi sku// rang gi 'thob byar smon pa ni// gnyis ka tshang ba'i skyabs 'gro ste// 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro zhes su grags// 'di nyid mchog yin gzhan rgyud la// grub zin gsum por skyabs 'cha' ba// 'khor ba'i 'jigs las skyob byed de// rgyu yi skyabs 'gro zhes su grags// nges don skyabs 'gro de skyes nas// sems bskyed logs su btsal mi dgos// tshad med bzhi dang sbyin sogs kyi// bsod nams tshogs chen sogs pa na// snang grags chos rnams gang la yang*// rtog pas cir yang mi 'dzin par// rnam shes ngo na snang cha tsam// ma dor sgo nas thams cad bya// bskyed pa'i rim pa la 'jug tshe// swa bhā'i sngags kyis gzung 'dzin gyi// spros kun mi dmigs par byas nas// chos dbyings ye shes lhag mar bzhag /rang gi chos dbyings ye shes de// nye bar len pa'i rgyur bzung nas// rten dang brten par bcas pa yi// dkyil 'khor mtha' dag tshul bzhin spro// de yis ma dag snang ba kun// rim gyis nub nas 'og min sogs// dag pa'i snang ba ngang gi 'char// rdzogs rim zhes pa bde stong dang*// rang byin rlabs pa nyid la zer// bde stong zhes pa rnam rtog gis// stong pa'i bde ba che la 'chad// bde chen zhes pa gzhi dus su// rang byung lhan skyes ye shes dang*// lam gyi dus su dkyil 'khor bzhi// dbu mar tshud la 'chad pa yin// rang byin rlab pa zhes bya ba// rdo rje'i lus bzang skyon med la// gnad du bsnun pas dkyil 'khor bzhi// dbu mar 'dzud pa'i thabs la zer// thabs de mngon du gyur pa na// 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku grub nas// zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur// mdor na gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi// 'od gsal ba las zung 'jug sku// sgrub pa'i rim pa mi shes na// rim gnyis sgom pa ming du zad// 'khor 'das dbyer med ces bya ba// snang grags chos la rnam rtog gi

/'dzin pa yod pa de srid du// 'khor ba zhes bya 'dzin med na// mya ngan 'das pa lhun gyis grub// gzhi yi dus su myang 'das las// ma gtogs chos 'ga' yod min zhing*// lam 'bras dus su chos kyi sku// nyag gcig bde ba chen po'i ngang*// zhes pa'i rten du ja sbyor cig /gser mdog can gyi chos grwa nas// yar gyi ngo la springs pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// //bshes gnyen dkon mchog grags pa yi// mchid shog rten dang dri bar bcas// 'phrod pas rjes su yi rang gyur// dri ba dang po rnam snang la// rnam snang nyid kyis rgyas gdab na// lus la lus kyi rgyas gdab par// song phyir gzhan dbang nyid la yang*// gzhan dbang nyid kyis rgyas 'debs par// thal 'gyur de la yongs grub kyis// rgyas 'debs bshad pa ci yin zer// ma dag phung po lnga so sor// sangs rgyas lnga po'i rigs can zhes// thag gcod byed tshe rgyu la ni/ 'bras bus rgyas 'debs zer ba yin// 'bras bu'i dus kyi sangs rgyas lnga// gzhi dus phung po lnga po yi// de nyid med na mi 'byung zhes// thag gcod byed pa 'bras bu la// rgyu yis rgyas 'debs zer ba yin// gzhi dus phung po lnga'i chos nyid// so sor sangs rgyas rigs lnga zhes// thag gcod ngo bo nyid la ni// ngo bo nyid kyis rgyas 'debs zer// lam gyi dus su sangs rgyas lnga// bsgrub tshul ma dag phung po rnams// gdod nas mi dmigs par byas te// so so'i chos dbyings sangs rgyas lnga// yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa// de tshe ngo bo nyid la ni// ngo bo nyid kyis rgyas 'debs pa// gsal por byon pa 'di nyid ni// rgyas 'debs kun gyi gtso bor bshad// ji srid rig pa'i dbang lnga po// rdzogs par ma thob de srid du// rnam snang lta bu gcig nyid la// gzhan gyi dbu rgyan mi 'thad kyang*// de rdzogs nas ni rigs gzhan pa// kun nam rdor sems gcig nyid kyi// dbu rgyan rung ngo rdor sems la// mi bskyod bdag por brgyan pa ni// rgyu'i rdor 'dzin 'bras bu yi// rdor 'dzin rigs las gzhan min par// dgongs so de la'ang de nyid kyis// dbu rgyan pa yang mchog tu dge

/rigs lnga bris pa'i tsa ga li// rin chen 'byung ldan dbang rdzas su// nges par dgos pa ma yin mod// phyag len de ltar mdzad pa'i tshe// rigs lnga kun gyis dbu brgyan pa// dgos pa min par tshig las shes// kun btags pa la gzhan dbang gi /rgyas 'debs zhes pa de dang der// snang tsam las gzhan chos gang zag /yod ma yin pa nyid la 'chad// gzhan dbang la ni yongs grub kyi// rgyas gdab ces pa gnyis med kyi// ye shes las gzhan gzung 'dzin gnyis// med par thag chod pa la dgongs// gnyis med ye shes lha dang ni// sngags rnams kun gyi sgrub gzhi yin// de sgrub pa las phung po khams// skye mched so so'i chos nyid kyi// rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan no// kha dog mthun pa'i rigs bdag la// rigs 'chol zhes pa sngon ma byung*// gsal stong 'dzin med yang dag gi /lam yin thos bsam la nges par// mi ltos dbang dang byin brlabs dang*// lus kyi byed bcings tshad ldan las// lam de 'byung ba gsang sngags pa'i// sgom chen kun gyi lugs yin no// rnam rtog mang ba rnam rtog tu// shes pa tsam gyis gang la chog /rnam rtog ngo bo la bltas pas// 'dzin med chos sku rang shar yin// lam dus dbang la bsnyen tshad du// 'khyol ba mang yang 'di mi shes// dkon mchog rnam gsum grags pa yi// byin rlabs khyed la 'pho bar shog /ces pa'i mtshon byed sbyor gcig la// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis rgyas btab phul// //dge ba'i bshes gnyen grags pa rgya mtsho'i chos kyi dri ba/ gsung shog bcas pa phebs pa rjes su yid rang*/ dri ba ni/ rab gnas kyi tshe rigs bdag 'chol na nyes dmigs mang po bskyed pa 'dra bas ma 'chol ba'i tshul ji ltar yin/ rgyu la 'bras bu'i rgyas 'debs dang*/ 'bras bu la rgyu'i rgyas 'debs dang*/ ngo bo nyid la ngo bo nyid kyis rgyas 'debs bya ba'i go ba gang yin zhes 'byung ngo*// lan la gsum las/

dang po la// rab tu gnas pa ni gnyis te/ don dam pa'i dang*/ kun rdzob pa'i'o// dang po ni/ cho ga la mi ltos te/ gdod ma nas dang po'i sangs rgyas nyid du grub zin pa'i phyir/ 'di yang ye shes kyi gzigs ngor yin gyi/ rnam shes kyi ngor ni cho ga la ltos dgos te/ sangs rgyas su ma grub pa zhig der sgrub dgos pa'i phyir// de la yang rnal 'byor gong ma gnyis dbang btsan dgos pa yin te/ bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi tshang dgos pa'i phyir/ gang zhig sangs rgyas su sgrub pa'i gzhi ni mi dang 'dra ba yin te/ kun rdzob du rnam smin gyi phung po dang lung ma bstan ras bris lta bu'o// gnas lugs la ni chos can de dang de dag gi chos dbyings ye shes so// ye shes de'i ngo bo la ni rigs so so'i dbye ba byar med de/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du rigs gcig pa'i phyir/ chos dbyings ye shes de phung khams skye mched so so'i chos nyid du song ba'i tshe ni rigs lnga dang brgyar yang 'byed pa ni chos can gyi dbye bas so// de'i tshe mi bskyod pa lta bu gcig gi rigs la yang rigs lnga char tshang bas na spyir btang du rigs 'chol ba mi srid do// de lta na yang rigs chen so sor nges pa rnams 'chol ma 'chol las sgrub thag nye ring dang brda chad kyi 'jogs mtshams la ni/ rigs chen so sor nges dgos te/ bskyed rim gyi mthar thug pa ni rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa nyid la 'jog dgos pa'i phyir/ de'i tshe dri ma dag pa'i chu rigs bdag tu song ba ni rgyu gzugs phung la 'bras bu rnam snang gis rgyas btab pa dang*/ dbang gi lha spyi bor thim pas rgyas btab pa ni 'bras bu rnam snang la rgyu gzugs phung gi rgyas btab pa dang*/ de gnyis la ma ltos par dbu rgyan rang bcas su bzhag pa ni ngo bo nyid la ngo bo nyid kyis rgyas btab pa'o// yang na rgyu ma dag pa'i phung po lnga 'bras bu sangs rgyas lnga'i rigs su 'jog pa ni rgyu la 'bras bu'i dang*/

'bras bu'i dus kyi sangs rgyas rigs lnga po de/ rgyu ma dag pa'i phung po lnga'i rigs su nges pa ni 'bras bu la rgyu'i rgyas 'debs pa ste/ bu pha'i rigs dang*/ me bud shing gi rigs su 'jog pa lta bu'o// mdor na dpon slob dang gnas bya'i lha gnyis ka ye shes nyid las sgrub dgos pa yin te/ phung sogs kun rdzob pa'i chos rnams sngags don bsam nas mi dmigs par byas zin pa'i 'og tu sa bon nam cho ga gsum mam/ mngon byang lnga las sgrub dgos pa'i phyir/ nges pa'i don du na sgrub gzhi chos dbyings gcig pur nges pas/ rigs bdag kyang rdo rje sems dpar ma 'dus pa med pa de'i phyir/ bsnyen sgrub kyi mthar lha thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan zhes brjod pa la/ rigs 'chol ba'i nyes pa ni yod pa ma yin no// de bzhin du rdo rje sems dpa' la mi bskyod pa rigs bdag tu song ba de'i tshe bla med kyi lha ji snyed pa la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan kyang rigs 'chol ba'i nyes pa med par sems te/ gzhi dus su rnam shes las ma gtogs pa'i kun rdzob mi srid pa'i phyir/ zhib mor na rig pa'i dbang snga ma rnams bskur ba sngon du ma song bar rigs lnga char gyis dbu brgyan pa mi 'byung la de med par rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du dbang bskur ba yang mi 'byung la/ de med par des dbu brgyan pa yang mi 'byung ba ni lha dang mi gnyis ka thog mar rab tu gnas pa'i go rim mo// rdo rje slob dpon rab kyis ni rang nyid kyi chos dbyings ye shes lung ma bstan ras bris lta bu'i tshe/ rab tu gnas bya'i bskyed pa yin la/ slob dpon 'bring gis ni rang las rdzas gzhan pa'i ye shes shig rab tu gnas bya'i lhar sgrub pa dang*/ tha mas ni lugs ma lta bu la mtshan mar zhen pa/ mi dmigs par byas nas/ lugs sku lta bu de nyid rab tu gnas bya'i lhar bsgrub pa'o// smras pa/

'di tsam kho na shes pas kyang*// mang pos bsngags pa'i grags dkar thob// nges don chos kyi rgya mtshor yang*// the tshom med par khyod kyis 'jug /sbyor chung cig gi rten bcas pa// hor zla lnga pa'i tshes la phul// //shu bhaṃ// ༈ //dag ljon skor gsum gyi dri ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa dka' ba'i gnas gsal ba'i me long zhes pa bzhugs// ༄// na maḥgu ra we/ shing rta'i srol chen 'byed po zhes// bsngags 'os bsngags pa'i bde thob nas// grub pa'i sa la rtag bzhugs pa// mthu stobs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal// de yis nges par byin brlabs pa'i// dpal ldan brtse ba chen po pa// sras dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs kyi// rgyal mtshan mthon po grub gyur cig /'di na rgyud gsum man ngag dang*// bcas pa'i mngon rtogs gzhung bzang po// rin chen ljon shing zhes bya ba// 'chad po rnams la 'di dri'o// gang zhig sangs rgyas snying po can// kun kyang rdo rje theg pa yi// snod du rung ba yin mod kyang*// 'jug tshul rnam pa gnyis gsungs pa// de la skal dman rim 'jug tshul// man ngag gzhung ji bzhin du ni// bkri ba'i tshul dang 'dir bshad pa// mi mthun pa de ji ltar yin// spyod pas rim 'jug 'chad pa'i tshe// 'khor ba kun las nges 'byung dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la// slob tshul mi 'chad pa de ci// so so thar pa'i bslab bya dang*// dge ba bcu la slob pa'i tshul// phan tshun gcig gis gcig bsdus par// 'chad pa 'di yang dka' ba'i gnas// lta ba rim 'jug 'chad pa'i tshe// mu stegs byed las khyad par du// nyan thos sde dang thun mong ba'i// lta ba ma bshad pa de ci// dngos por smra ba'i sde gsum po// phyi mas snga ma 'gog pa'i tshul// 'chad dgos yin mod snga ma yi// grub mtha' 'khrul la 'jug mi dgos// bye brag smra ba'i grub mtha' la// gcig char ba yi rgyun zhugs dang*// mdo sde pa yi grub pa'i mthar// sa bcu stong nyid bcu drug dang*// sku gsum la sogs dka' ba'i gnas// mngon pa kun las btus pa na// sems tsam grub mtha' 'chad pa'i tshul// 'ga' yang med ces 'chad na ni// dka' ba'i gnas ni shin tu mang*// mdo sde rgyan gzhung sems tsam gyi// bstan bcos yin pas rigs chad kyi// sems can 'dod ces zer na yang*// bshad par dka' ba shin tu mang*// rnal 'byor spyod pa pa zhes pa// sems tsam pa dang don gcig tu// 'chad par mngon mod rnam bden dang*// rnam brdzun dbye ba mi 'chad ci// rje btsun rtse mos sems tsam dang*// dbu ma'i lta ba thun mong du// gnyis med rang rig rang gsal ba// yin zhes zer ba ci la dgongs// gzhan dbang bden grub ces bya ba// sems tsam lta ba yin mod kyi// rnal 'byor spyod pa'i mthar thug gi

/lta bar gzhung nas bshad pa med// rnal 'byor spyod gzhung rgya mtsho yi// pha rol phyin pa'i dbu ma la// thal rang smra bas sems tsam zhes// smra ba shin tu mang mod kyang*// des kyang de la chad smra zhes// zer phyin dbu ma'i bstan bcos ni// shing rta'i srol 'byed gnyis po la// 'chad tshul mthun par yod pa min// des na ljon shing lta ba yang*// rnal 'byor spyod dang thun mong ba// nyid phyir de la sems tsam zhes// zer ba shin tu dka' ba'i gnas// de rjes dbu ma bstan zhes pa// thal rang kho nar 'chad na ni// lta ba'i mthar thug der 'chad dam// de las gzhan yang yod par 'chad// dang po ltar na man ngag gi /rnam 'grel kun las thos bsam gyi// lta ba dug can yin par bshad// gnyis pa ltar na chos kyi rjes// pha rol phyin pa'i spros bral las// lhag pa'i lta ba yod na ni// zhes sogs gsungs pa ci la dgongs// 'chad po rnams kyis gsal bar smros// ngo bo nyid med smra byed pa'i// dbu ma'i dbye ba lngar bshad nas// rab tu mi gnas mchog min zhes// bshad na mchog gi mtshan gzhi gang*// dbye ba rnam lnga gang nas bshad// gnyis med rnam rgyal khungs su dka'// bye smra dang mthun mtshan gzhi dkon// sgyu ma pa ni su la zer// thal 'gyur 'dod pa 'dir sun phyung*// de la mi gnas zer ba dka'// rang rgyud 'dod pa'ang de bzhin du// bkag phyir dbu ma bstan pas ci// mi gnas pa la zung 'jug dang*// rgyun chad gnyis su su yis 'dod// gnyis ka lugs 'dis sun phyung phyir// mi gnas mchog tu ji ltar 'chad// zla grags rang rgyud mi 'dod cing*// mnyam gzhag ye shes khas len phyir// de dag las gzhan dbu ma pa// mchog tu 'dod pa yin zhe na// spros pa mtha' dag bkag rjes su// mnyam gzhag ye shes khas len pa// zung 'jug mi gnas pa dang ni// rnal 'byor spyod pa las gzhan med// de rjes kyai yi rdo rje zhes// bshad pa de la dbu ma las// lhag pa'i lta ba yod dam med// yod na spros pa can du 'gyur// med na lta ba rim 'jug gi

/mthar thug nyid du bshad pa ci// lta ba'i mthar thug zung 'jug don// zung du 'brel bar 'chad pa nor// so sor thar pa rigs bdun dang*// rdzas su bzhi yi grangs nges la// dge slob ma yi sdom pa zhes// bgrangs la zhus dag dgos yin nam// de ltar dris pa de dag gi /lan 'debs shes na rgyas par smos// mi shes na yang tshig 'bru tsam// klog pas nyes chen skyed mi nus// gsang sngags lta ba'i gnas 'di la// nus// rigs pas phu thag ma dpyad na// lta ba rtogs par mi nus zhes// phyi rabs pa kun mthun smra ba// 'di ni sngags kyi lugs min te// rtogs bya'i lta ba gcig nyid kyang*// rtogs byed thabs kyi khyad par ni// pha rol phyin pa la med par// sngags la yod ces gsungs pa yin// skabs der rtogs bya'i lta ba yang*// chos dbyings ye shes la 'chad pa// thal rang gzhung dang mi mthun yang*// 'khor lo gsum pa'i gzhung lugs yin// rtogs byed thabs kyi khyad par ni// dbu mar ye shes phab pa dang*// lus kyi byed pa bcings pa dang*// byin rlabs rim pa sogs la bzhed// thos bsam rigs pas gsang sngags kyi// don dam nyid du gang bshad pa// de la mtshan mar 'dzin pa yi// rtog pa ma lus 'gog nus kyang*// rigs pas btsal tshe ma rnyed tsam// sngags kyi don dam dngos min phyir// rigs pa rkyang pas gsang sngags kyi// don dam rtogs par nus mi bzhed// la la dbu ma'i rigs pa ni// stong nyid rtogs pa'i thabs min par// rje btsun mched kyi bshad pa'i phyir// pha rol phyin la de med zer// pha rol phyin pas stong pa nyid// rtogs pa med na lam lnga dang*// sa bcu'i rim pas rang lugs kyi// rdzogs sangs rgya bar gsungs dang 'gal// pha rol phyin par stong pa nyid// don dam bden par mi 'dod kyang*// yul can stong nyid du 'dres pa// de tshe stong nyid rtogs shes brjod// de nyid rim gyis goms pa yis// sgrib gnyis sa bon bcas spong zhing*// rjes thob dus su bsod nams kyi// tshogs bsags pa las rdzogs 'tshang rgya// mtshan nyid theg par mnyam gzhag gi

/dus su blo med khas blangs kyang*// sngags lugs bzhin du bde chen gyi// ye shes med mi rung ma yin// 'o na 'khor lo gsum pa yi// dbu ma'i lugs la'ang de yin nam// zhe na min te lugs der ni// gzung 'dzin gnyis po rang stong du// gtan la phab nas gnyis med kyi// ye shes lhag ma bzhag pa de// mnyam gzhag so sor rang rig pa'i// myong bya nyid du bshad pa yin// dngos po'i gnas lugs shes bya ba// gcig kyang yod pa min no zhes// gsungs pa de dang lhan skyes kyi// ye shes gnas lugs su bshad pa// 'di la 'gal ba yod min te// rigs pas gtan la 'bebs pa dang*// sgom pas nyams su myong bya ba// so so'i dbang du byas pa yin// mngon rtogs rin chen ljon shing du// mtha' bral gtan la 'bebs pa dang*// zung 'jug nyams su len pa zhes// bya ba'i skabs gnyis so sor phye// 'o na rigs pas dpyad pa nyid// nyams len min pa ci zhe na// mtha' bral gtan la 'bebs shes pa// rtogs bya rtogs pa'i phyir min gyi// rtogs bya de la mtshan 'dzin gyi// spros pa 'gog pa'i phyir yin no// des na rtogs bya rtogs pa'i thabs// sngags su bshad pa des chog kyang*// rtogs bya de la mtshan 'dzin gyi// spros pa 'gog pa'i rigs pa ni// rgyud kyi lta ba rim 'jug dang*// 'khor lo gsum gyi go rim ltar// rigs pa thog mar bshad byas nas// zung 'jug rjes su bshad pa yin// rtogs bya'i lta ba sngar myong ba// de la bdag dang gang zag tu// 'khrul pa 'gog phyir rigs pa ni// rjes su bshad na'ang 'gal ba med// dper na rnal 'byor spyod pa yi// myong bya bstan pa'i rjes thogs su// dbu ma bstan par bya'o zhes// rgyud las bshad pa de bzhin no// de phyir dbu ma'i rigs pa ni// nges par dgos pa yin zhe na// rgyud du bshad pa'i gzung 'dzin gyi// rtog pa 'gog pa'i thabs kho nas// 'gog par nus pa ma yin pa'i// rtog pa yod pa ma yin no// 'khor 'das dbyer med du bshad pa'i// snang ba sems sogs gsum po ni// thal rang gzhung gi lugs min kyang*// gsum pos mtshan 'dzin ma lus sel// rigs pa'i ngo na med pa dang*// dngos po'i gnas lugs su yod pa// gnyis la gtso bor gang 'dzin zhes// zer ba byung na 'di lta ste// sgra rtog yul du gang gyur pa'i// kun rdzob chos rnam shes brjod kyi// rigs pa'i ngo na med pa nyid// yod pa min pa'i shes byed mchog

/sgra rtog yul las 'das pa yi// bde chen ye shes rigs pa'i ngor// yod pa min kyang gnas lugs la// yod pa yi ni dam pa'o// ngo bo nyid med smra ba rnams// rigs pas btsal tshe chos gang yang*// rnyed pa min phyir chos rnams kun// yod pa min zhes 'chad pa yin// thos bsam rigs pa dbu ma las// lhag pa sngags la yod min kyang*// nyams su myong bya dbu ma las// lhag pa sngags la yod ces byos// de nas rang bzhin lhan skyes nyid// don dam bden pa dngos yin par// bshad la rtsod pa'i rnam grangs ni// mang por gyur pa de spang bya// rang bzhin lhan skyes phar phyin gyi// theg pa'i rigs pas 'ol spyi tsam// yul du byas pa de kun rdzob// nyid phyir don dam rnam grangs pa// sngags kyi theg pa'i thabs mkhas kyis// de mngon byas la dpe dang ni// don gyi ye shes rnam gnyis las// phyi ma don dam dngos yin mod// snga ma'i dus su mtshan 'dzin gyi// rtog pa'i 'jug ldog las ma grol// de phyir don dam dngos min te// tha mal dus kyi bden ba bzhin// sems can kun la lhan skyes kyi// ye shes chen pos khyab gyur kyang*// nyams su myong ba'i rang rig ni// 'jig rten pa la yod ma yin// yod na so so skye bo yis// chos nyid mngon sum mthong bar 'gyur// dpe yi ye shes chos nyid la// rtog dang bral zhing ma 'khrul ba'i// cha nas bzhag pa yin mod kyang*// de la mngon sum ma yin no// tha mal dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi// bde ba dpe yi ye shes su// 'chad nus min kyang lung de dag /de de'i sgrub byed du 'brel ba// tha mal dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi// bde ba lus kyi tshor ba nyid// yin phyir rtog dang bcas pa ste// mngon par zhen pas bcings phyir ro// bdag byin brlab pa'i rim pa las// byung ba'i dpe yi ye shes kyang*// de ma thag tu mngon zhen gyi// rnam par rtog dang 'dres gyur na// lus tshor bde las ma 'das pa// de nyid don dam du mi rung*// rnam par rtog dang bral gyur na// zag med bde ba cha mthun pa// yin phyir lus tshor nyid ma yin// lung rnams de yi shes byed min// don dam mngon sum rtogs pa ni// 'phags pa min la mi srid phyir// 'di nyid don dam dngos yin zhes// ngos 'dzin nus de 'phags kho na// dpe tsam gyis ni mtshon nus pa// 'jig rten pa la'ang srid pa'i tshe// de la dpe yi ye shes zhes// gsang sngags pa rnams tha snyad 'dogs// de phyir lus kyi byed bcings las// du sogs mtshan ma shar ba na// rtogs mkhan so so skye bo'i phyir// don dam bden pa dngos min no// ngo bo nyid med smra ba rnams// don dam bden pa 'di yin zhes// ngos 'dzin nus pa gzhan ci smos// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyang yod mi 'dod// ye shes chen po phar phyin dang*// rgyud sde kun gyi rtogs bya zhes// gsungs pa 'dis ni phar phyin du// ye shes lta ba'i rtogs byar bstan// der yang ma zad theg chen gyi// tshul gnyis rtogs bya gcig par bshad// de yang 'khor lo gsum pa yi// nges don nyid las gzhan min phyir// gnyis med ye shes don dam pa'i// bden par 'dod pa sems tsam pa// yin zhes gzhan gyi zer lugs kun// dbyangs su len par ma byed cig

/bskyed rim dus kyi lha dang sngags// ye shes 'di nyid las sgrub mod// sgrub mkhan rtog pa nyid kyi phyir// don dam dngos su bzhag mi nus// skyed rim dus kyi lha dang sngags// ye shes nyid las gzhan min par// go byed thabs ni rdzogs rim gyi// rang byin brlab pa'i rim par bshad// phar phyin theg pa rkyang pa yis// sa rnams bgrod pa'i 'phags pa de// nye rgyus mtshams sbyor byed pa'i tshe// thog ma kho nar stong pa nyid// bde ba chen po'i ngo bor skye// bde ba che las logs shig tu// stong nyid dmigs su med pa ni// thog mar dpe yi ye shes su// skye zhes bshad pas chog mod kyang*// mtshan 'dzin rtog pa las grol na// don gyi ye shes kho na'o// skal ldan gcig char ba la 'ga'// dpe yi ye shes skyes pa na// de la mtshan 'dzin 'gog pa'i thabs// man ngag nyid kyi lugs ji bzhin// sbyangs pas spros pa 'gog nus mod// klu sgrub zhabs kyi rigs pa'am// thogs med mched kyi rigs pa nyid// sbyangs pas rtog pa kun 'joms so// rang bzhin lhan skyes zhes bya ba// don dam bden pa dngos yin mod// yul can rtog par gyur pa'i tshe// rnam grangs pa yi don dam dang*// yul can rtog bral ma 'khrul ba// yin pa'i tshe na don dam dngos// zhu bde zhes pa rang bzhin gyi// lhan skyes rtogs pa'i thabs su bshad// de la rang byin brlab pa dang*// gsum pa'i gnas skabs dbye bas gnyis// gnyis ka'ang bdag rkyen lus dbang las// byung phyir lus tshor bde bar bzhag /bde ba de nyid zag bcas kyang*// bde ba'i ngo bo myong rig de// spros kun bral phyir zag med dang*// mtshon byed dpe yi ye shes so// dpe yi ye shes 'byung ba las// gyur pa'i bde ba ma yin mod// lus tshor bde ba de med par// dpe yi ye shes de mi 'byung*// don gyi ye shes lus tshor gyi// bde ba'i rten la rag ma las// zhu bde'i thabs las mngon gyur pa'i// rang bzhin lhan skyes ye shes de// 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang bral ba// de tshe 'phags pa'i ye shes so// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas skabs kyi// zung 'jug rnam pa gsum du dbye// gzhi dus ye shes rang bzhin gyi// rtog pa'i rnyog pa dang bral dang*// lam dus thabs kyi khyad par las// rtog pa ngang gis 'gags pa dang*// 'bras dus sems kyi rdo rje ni// rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba// 'di ni gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi// zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen ste// ngo bo nyid med smra ba la// rnam gzhag 'di dag yod ma yin// de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba// mu stegs byed la'ang bskyed rim dang*// rang byin brlab pa'i rim pa las// rlung sems dbu mar zhugs pa yod// de tshe rtog pa dang bral ba'i// rang rig de la gang zag gi

/bdag tu grub mthas 'dogs pa'i phyir// 'khor ba'i 'dam las grol mi srid// mu stegs byed kyi gsang sngags pa// rang byin brlab pa'i rim pa la// sbyangs pa'i mthu grub 'dod khams pa// rten des gzugs khams bgrod pa yod// mu stegs byed 'ga' mnyam gzhag tu// gsal stong 'dzin med 'char na yang*// chos kun bdag med lta ba yi// grub pa'i mtha' la ma zhugs pa// de srid thar pa'i lam dang bral// de phyir gsal stong 'dzin med tsam// lta ba mchog tu ma smra zhig /de nas dri ba phyi ma yi// lan yang bsdus par bshad bya ba// mi yi rten can 'dod khams su// tshe gcig nyid la sangs rgyas pa'i// gnas de 'dod pa'i khams nyid dam// 'og min stug po bkod pa zhes// 'di na stug po bkod pa las// gzhan du smra bar ga la nus// ji srid gnyis snang ma dag pa// de srid 'dod pa'i khams su btags// bag chags dag tshe rten brten pa// thams cad chos kyi dbyings su gcig /chos kyi sku yi ye shes la// gnas gzhan rnam pa mi 'char yang*// de nyid byang sems 'phags pa la// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur snang tshe// chos dbyings gnas su gang shar ba// de nyid stug po bkod par shes// ma dag 'jig rten snang ba kun// 'di yi nang du ma 'dus med// gzugs kyi khams kyi 'og min sogs// bshad pa drang ba'i don can no// sngags kyi sangs rgyas nye rgyu yis// nges par mtshams sbyor dgos zhes pa// mi yi rten gyi tshe gcig la// rdzogs sangs rgya ba'i dbang du mdzad// nyon sgrib spangs pa'i dgra bcom dang*// gong ma'i rten can phyir mi 'ong*// gzugs rten can gyi sa bcu pa// de la sogs pa gsang sngags kyi// thabs kyi rdzogs sangs rgya ba la// spyod pa rnam gsum spyod pa dang*// nye rgyus mtshams sbyor dgos ma yin// spyod pa zhes bya 'dod pa yi// yon tan lnga la zhen med par// sim par longs spyod pa la zer// 'dod sred spangs pas de mi nus// bye brag nye rgyu'i nye lam ni// lus tshor bde ba 'dod chags dang*// mtshungs ldan nges rtog dang bral ba// de med par ni yod ma yin// de yang rang byin brlab pa dang*// las kyi phyag rgya bsten la rag

/khams gong rten dang dgra bcom la// de dag srid pa ma yin no// de dag sngags kyis 'tshang rgya ba// shes rab pha rol phyin ma dang*// lhan skyes ye shes zung chud pa// de tshe phyag rgya chen mo dang*// zung du 'jug pa'i rdo rje 'chang*// mi 'gyur bde ba chen po dang*// mchog gi dngos grub ces byar bshad// 'di ni rang bzo ma yin te// mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i bcud phyung ba// sa skya'i rje btsun mched bcas kyi// gzhung lugs lta ba'i mig yin no// 'di yis lta bar mi nus pa'i// dag ljon skor gsum nges pa'i don// rmongs dang som nyi'i mun khung du// lus pa 'ga' yang yod ma yin// de yi dge bas bdag dang ni// nges don khang par chabs gcig tu// chas pa'i don mthun slob ma'i tshogs// zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin thob shog /ces mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing zhes bya ba'i dngos bstan gyi dka' gnas la som nyi'i mtha' rnam par dpyad nas/ gsang sngags bla na med pa'i yid bzhin gyi rgya mtshor 'jug pa/ nges don rin po che'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po che'i zham ring pa/ lung dang las kas nye bar phyug pa dag gi rgyud 'dzin/ 'phan yul dga' mo pa padma dbang rgyal zhes bya bas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor bgyis nas/ bka' 'khor lo bar mtha' gnyis kyi nges pa'i don/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan chos skyong zhabs kyis shing rta'i srol ji ltar phye ba bzhin du dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos nye bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan no// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //sdom gsum rab dbye la dri ba legs pa bzhugs// ༄// na mo wa gi shwa ra ya/ rig pa'i gnas la ma rmongs shing*// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde la// mkhyen pa gsal zhing thugs gzu ba// de dag kun la 'di 'dri'o// de yang 'di ltar sdom pa gsum gyis rab tu dbye ba zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las brtsams te dri ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa dogs pa'i gnas brgya dang brgyad pa zhes bya ba/

rab mdzes mtshan dpe gsar pa'i lang tsho can// rab dkar gangs ri'i ljongs su byon gyur pa// rab 'byams mkhas pa'i dbang pos paṇa chen la// rab dang rnyog pa med pas phyag bgyi'o// khyod nyid legs bshad rna bar nyan cing 'jebs// yid la 'bab cing tshig don gzung sla bar// gyur kyang ma shes the tshom gnas 'ga' zhig /khyod nyid rjes 'jug rnam dpyod gsal ldan cing*// thos par ldan la khyad gsod min pa'i blos// rnam par rtags te gus pas dri bar bya// chos kyi 'bel gtam yid 'ong padmo'i phreng*// snyan grags nor bu'i mdangs dang lhan cig tu// rnam dpyod 'dzum ldan gzhan gyi rna ba la// legs par rgyud mkhas de dag kun la dad// nyan thos lugs la so thar gyi// sdom pa rig byed min pa'i gzugs// kho nar bshad pa gang na yod// rig byed gzugs kyang ma bshad dam// nyan thos so thar mkhan slob kyi// lus ngag las ni skye zhes pa// gzhung gi dgongs pa yin na ni// sdom pa'i thob rgyu bcu med dam// gzugs can yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi// shi bas gtong na bsam gtan dang*// zag med gnyis la mi thal lam// theg chen lugs la spong ba'i sems// ji srid ma nyams de srid du// de yi sdom pa de yod na// theg chen lugs kyi bsnyen gnas kyang*// nang par phan chad bsrung dgos sam// des na ji srid sems ma nyams// zhes dang sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i// dge slong la sogs sdom pa rnams// zhes sogs mi 'gal tshul de ci// so thar sdom pa shi nas kyang*// yod ces smra ba'i 'bri khung pas// theg pa chen po'i so thar gyi// dbang du byas par ma bshad dam// bye smra'i bsnyen gnas dge slong la// ldan pa'i dmigs bsal gang na yod// 'dul ba'i lugs kyi bsnyen gnas kyi// cho ga gsal po gang na bzhugs// dud 'gro so so thar pa yi// sdom pa'i rten du khas len pa'i// nyan thos sde pa yod dam ci// mdo sde pa rnams bsnyen gnas ni// ji ltar 'dod tshe len ces pa// dus gcig stabs su len nam ci// zas zos nas kyang len ces pa// de yi don du khas len na// de 'dra bye brag smra ba yi// nang par gzhan la nod ces pa'i// dmigs bsal yin gyi skabs kyi ni// rtsod pa'i lan du 'gyur ba med// bsnyen gnas dus gcig len pa de// mdo sde'i gzhung lugs gang na yod// gsang sngags lugs kyi bsnyen gnas la// yi dam bsgom pa mchog yin na// lha de bdag mdun gang yin brtags// bdag bskyed yin na bya rgyud kyi// rang rkang bdag bskyed med pa ci// mdun bskyed yin na rnam rgyal sogs// ma bskyed gong du gso sbyong gi

/sdom pa len pa mdzad dam ci// rnam rgyal don zhags la sogs pa'i// cho ga byed pa'i dge tshul dang*// dge slong gis ni gso sbyong ni// rang gis blangs pa'i dgos pa ci// dge bsnyen bzang po bsnyen gnas ni// yan lag tshang bar mnos pa'i tshe// gnad bcos pa yi tshig de yis// sngar gyi sdom pa mi 'jig gam// dge ba gang yin thams cad kyi// rnam smin bde ba bskyed na ni// zag med dge ba'i rnam smin ci// btang snyoms gnyis ka ma yin na// bsam gtan bzhi pa yan chad kyi// zag bcas dge ba'i rnam smin dang*// btang snyoms zhes pa lung ma bstan// yin na kun gzhi'i sa bon las// rnam smin 'byung ba de ci zhig /las dkar zhes pa dge ba la// 'chad na rnam smin gnag pa ci// las nag ces pa sdig pa la// zer na rnam smin dkar ba ci// rgyu yi kun slong sdig yin na// dus kyi kun slong dge yin kyang*// las de dkar por mi 'gyur zhes// mngon pa gong mar ma bshad dam// dus kyi kun slong mi dge ba// dag dang mtshungs pa'i dge ba ni// mo gsham bu dang 'dra'o zhes// mngon pa gong mar mi 'byung ngam// rgyu yi kun slong 'phen byed kyi// gtso bo yin phyir 'phen byed rgyu// dus kyi kun slong 'grub byed kyi// gtso bo yin phyir 'grub byed rgyur// gong 'og mthun par gsung min nam// 'dod pa'i rten la dkar nag gis// las gnyis 'dres mar 'jog pa bzhin// rnam par smin pa'ang 'dres sam ci// de lta na ni ngan song dang*// mtho ris rnam smin rgyud gcig la// srid par khas len mi dgos sam// chos dbyings dge ba ma yin na// mngon rtogs rgyan dang rgyud bla dang*// dbus rnam 'byed par gsung de ci// sdig pa med tsam la dgongs na// ma sgribs lung bstan min kun ci// yod pa nyid la mi rtag pas// khyab par chos kyi grags pas gsungs// yod pa tsam la des khyab par// rigs pa'i gzhung lugs gang gis ston// klu sgrub kyi ni dbu ma las// dngos med la'ang 'dus byas kyis// khyab par gsungs pa ma yin nam// de lta yin na chos kyi dbyings// 'dus byas yin par mi thal lam// rin chen phreng bar gsungs pa yi// zab mo bkrol ba ci la zer// stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can// bde gshegs snying po ma yin na// rgyas 'gyur rigs la bde gshegs kyi// snying por gsungs pa de ci zhig

/chos dbyings rdzogs pa'i byang chub rgyur// 'gyur ba med na chos kyi dbyings// rgyu yi rigs su 'jog de ci// 'phags pa'i chos kyi rgyu yi phyir// chos dbyings rigs su 'jog go zhes// tshad ldan gzhung las gsung de ci// chos dbyings dam pa'i chos dang ni// dam pa ces bya dge ba la// tshad ldan gzhung las ma gsungs sam// chos dbyings ngo bo bdag med la// bde chen sgyu ma'i sku de yang*// dge ba min par bzhed lags sam// de lta na ni bstod pa las// dge ba zhes kyang ma gsungs sam// chos dbyings lung ma bstan yin na// chos kyi dbyings las ma gtogs pa'i// chos gzhan med phyir dge ba dang*// sdig pa'ang lung ma bstan du 'gyur// snyam pa'i dogs pa mi 'byung ngam// chos dbyings gsum kar mi rung na// de mtshungs dogs pa'ang ci mi 'byung*// chos dbyings yod par mi bzhed na// chos kyi dbyings las ma gtogs pa'i// dngos po med pa'i dngos po kun// yod par mi bzhed de ci zhig /yod pa sgrub par gsungs pa yi// chos dbyings dge bar ji ltar gnod// mi 'gyur bsngo ba don med na// tshong dpon mdza' bo'i bu mo yis// smon lam btab pa de ci zhig /chos nyid bsngo rgyur byed pa ni// blo sbyong du yang mi rung na// gnas min bsngo ba gsungs de ci// ma byas pa yi dge med na// theg pa chen po bsdus pa las// thog med dus nas ma byas pa'i// kun gzhi steng gi zag med kyi// sa bon dge bar bshad de ci// de 'dra med na kun gzhi yi// gnyen por bshad pa de gang yin// bde gshegs snying po gang yin pa// de dag 'dus ma byas yin na// theg pa chen po rgyud bla mar// snying po dgur gsungs pa de ci// sems can ma gtogs bem po yi// chos dbyings snying po ma yin na// rgyud dang sems 'grel bskor gsum las// brtan g.yo kun la sangs rgyas kyi// snying po yod par gsung de ci// gos hrul nang na rin chen gyis// dpe bstan dgongs pa can yin na// sems can rnams la rang bzhin gyi// gnas rigs med par mi 'gyur ram// bsngo ba'i tshe na chu sgreng ba// rang lugs min nam 'dul ba las// lag chu zad par gsung de ci// chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis bskyed pa'i// las kun mi dge ba yin na// zag bcas dge ba gti mug gis// kun slong dag las 'byung de ci// dge rtsa gsum gyis kun bslangs pa'i// las kun dge ba yin na ni// rgyu'i kun slong dge ba yi// bslangs kyang dus kyi kun slong ni// nyon mongs can dang mtshungs ldan pa'i// mi dge ba de ci zhig yin// de 'dra med na ded dpon gyis// tshong pa g.yo can bsad de ci// mi mkhas pa yi byams snying rje// ngan song rgyu ru bzhed gyur na// 'phen byed rgyu'am rdzogs byed kyi// rgyu zhes brtags na ji ltar 'gyur// dge bsnyen dge tshul sdom brtson la'ang*// zhes par ltung ba thams cad la// sdig pas khyab par gsungs pa dang*// rje btsun chen po'i bcas ltung dag

/lung ma bstan du bshad pa ci// nyan thos sde pa bco brgyad la// 'dul ba bco brgyad yod ces pa'i// lung khungs gsal po gang na yod// 'dul ba yi ger bris pa ni// bka' bsdu gsum pa yin zhes grags// dus der 'dul ba bco brgyad po// thams cad yi ger bris sam ci// byin len ma byas za ba yi// ltung ba dge slong bslab byin la// 'byung zhing des kyang dge slong la// byin len rung bar bshad de ci// sdug bsngal kun gyi byed pa po// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma yin yang*// bde ba'i byed po rdzogs sangs rgyas// yin par bshad na skyon ci yod// theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed la// dbu ma sems tsam lugs gnyis su// nges shing len pa'i cho ga dang*// ltung ba phyir bcos la sogs pa// so sor nges na rgyud sde las// gsungs pa'i sems bskyed cho ga de// gnyis po gang gi lugs dang mthun// lta bas cho ga khyad 'byed na// dbu ma'i lta ba dang ldan pa// de la byang sa'i cho ga yis// sems bskyed sdom pa mi skye'am// bslab btus las gsungs rtsa ba yi// ltung bar byang sa las gsungs pa'i// rtsa ba'i ltung bar 'dus so zhes// bslab btus nyid las gsungs de ci// dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi// rten du so thar mi dgos na// yan lag bdun pa sngon 'gro bar// gsungs pa'i dgongs pa gang zhig yin// rje btsun rtse mo'i rgyun bshags kyi// dus su nyes spyod sdom pa yi// tshul khrims skye zhing de nyid kyang*// so so thar par bshad de ci// so so thar pa rigs bdun po// sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi// rten du dgos na rje btsun gyi// de dag de yi rten min par// gsungs pa'i dgongs pa gang du btsal// don dam sems bskyed bya ba yi// cho ga rgyal bas ma gsung na// 'phags pa klu sgrub skyob nyid kyi// byang chub sems 'grel ces bya ba'i// bstan bcos dag las gsung de ci// padma yo ga tsitta sogs// slob mas bzlas de kun rdzob dang*// don dam sems bskyed 'dzin bcug nas// sū ra ste sa mā ya zhes sogs kyis// skyes zin brtan par mdzad de ci// nyan thos rnams kyi rdzogs byang du// bsngo ba byed na 'phags pa yi// nyan thos theg pa de las ni// spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad ces// bya ba'i dgongs pa gang du btsal// thams cad sgrol gyi skye rabs las// bdag gi bram ze 'dod pa la// zhes sogs bsngo ba bshad pa de// nyan thos bsngo ba yin bzhed dam// dbang bzhi blangs pas sdom pa gsum// thob par gyur na dbang gong las// thob pa'i gsang sngags sdom pa dang*// dbang las thob pa'i so thar dang*// sems bskyed sdom pa bzhed lags sam// rdo rje phag mo 'ga' zhig gi

/dbang bzhi tshad ldan gzhung las bshad// de dag smin byed dbang bskur du// rung ngam mi rung gang yin dri// rdo rje phag mo'i byin brlabs la// sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga dang*// dkyil 'khor dang ni dbang bskur ba// rang lugs la yang mi bzhed dam// byin brlabs chos sgor mi bzhed na// rdzogs rim 'ga' zhig nyan pa'i sngar// byin brlabs nges par mdzad de ci// rang byung nas ni tshul shog bar// sngon chog yin par gang du bshad// gsang ba spyi rgyud dag las ni// dkyil 'khor dag tu dbang bskur bas// slob ma gnyis dang bzhi la sogs// zung du bshad pa 'ga' zhig yod// lha yang nyi ma shar ba na// nges par mchod nas gshegs dgos na// sta gon dngos gzhi'i bar du yang*// mchod nas gshegs gsol byed dgos sam// slob ma smin byed slob dpon gyi// dkyil 'khor dag tu dbang bskur nas// phag mo'i byin brlabs mdzad de ci// smin byed min pa'i dbang bskur las// sdom gsum thob pa yod dam med// med na de las gang zhig thob// yod na de yang smin byed du// thal bar 'gyur ba ma yin nam// des na smin byed ma yin pa'i// dbang bskur bzhed dam mi bzhed 'dri// rgyud sde 'og ma gsum po la// dbang bzhi rim gnyis mi rung na// rgyud sde gong ma'i rgyas bkab nas// rung bar 'chad pa 'di ci zhig /rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs nas// smin grol gnyis la 'bad dgos shing*// smin grol rim gnyis la bzhed na// rgyud sde 'og ma'i rang rkang las// sangs rgyas bsgrub pa ji ltar bya// de la'ang smin grol mi bzhed dam// rang rang gzhung bzhin byas chog na// dbang dang rim gnyis mi ldan pas// rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa min// ces sogs gsungs pa ci la dgongs// dbang bskur sems bskyed ma thob kyang*// don zhags la sogs sgrub rung na// do bskor ba yi dri lan las// rnam rgyal don zhags la sogs la// sems bskyed thob nas 'byongs dgos par// gsungs pa'i dgos pa gang du btsal// bya rgyud rnal 'byor rgyud gsum gyi// bsgom chen gang de pha rol du// phyin pa'i bsgom chen du bzhed dam// phar phyin theg par 'tshang rgya bar// sngags kyi theg pa'i nye lam la// ltos par bzhed na 'di nyid las// gal te 'di bzhin bsgrub 'dod na// gtum mo la sogs thabs lam bral// phyag rgya chen po'i tha snyad med// ces sogs gsungs pa ci la dgongs// mi ltos na ni bdag med ma'i// bstod pa'i 'grel par gsungs de ci// bcu gcig kun du 'od kyi sa// de la mi ltos bcu gsum pa// sngags la ltos par bzhed ce na// kun du 'od sa bcu gcig pa// yin par sngags gzhung gang las gsungs// sa bcu'i tha mar bdud 'dul ba'i// bshad pa gzhung lugs gang na bzhugs// mu stegs byed la sogs pa las// byung ba'i dge ba yod min na// mngon pa'i gzhung las mu stegs la// bsam gtan sdom pa bshad de ci// rgyud sde 'og ma'i dbang bskur las// sngags kyi sdom pa thob bam ci// thob na dbang bzhi gsang sngags kyi// thob rgyur bshad pa ji ltar yin// rdzogs rim sdom pa zhes bya yang*// bsgom pa'i stobs kyis thob mod kyi// dbang chog las thob gsungs pa med// rgyud sde 'og ma'i sngags sdom ni// med par bzhed na 'di nyid las// dbang bskur sdom pas ma sbrel na// bzang yang pha rol phyin pa yin// zhes gsungs pa de gang la dgongs// sdom pa med la dge ba'i rgyun// med na sems bskyed cho ga las// de de yod pa gsungs de ci// phyag rgya bzhi pa zhes bya ba'i// bstan bcos bod na bzhugs pa 'di// klu sgrub kyi ni ma mdzad par// lo chen 'gos kyi bshad de ci// lus rgya zhig pa'i shi ma thag

/yon tan 'byung ba 'gog mdzad na// 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku las// bar do longs sku 'byung de ci// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa yi// sangs rgyas rgyan can rgyan med du// thal ba 'dod pa ma yin nam// dge slong sdom pa ma thob par// mkhan po byas pas chog pa zhig /'dul ba'i mdo dang lung dag tu// gsal bar gsung ba ma yin nam// kha 'bar ma yi gtor ma la// de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi yi mtshan// sngon la brjod pa mi 'thad na// rje btsun grags pas mdzad de ci// na ma sarba ta thā sogs// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la// phyag 'tshal ba yi tshig min nam// sman pa'i rgyal po'i mdo gang de// mdo rgyud gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i// mdo ru bzhed dam rgyud yin grang*// dang po ltar na de las ni// sngags kyi cho ga 'byung ba ci// gnyis pa ltar na skabs kyi ni// dpyod pa'i lan du ji ltar 'gyur// ltung bshags sngags lugs mi bzhed na// bstan bcos mdzad pa 'di nyid kyis// sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa lnga po// rigs lnga bsdus pa ji ltar yin// sher snying sngags su bkral ba'i lugs// klu sgrub kyi ni ma mdzad dam// shes rab pha rol phyin ma nyid// sngags kyi lha ru gsung min nam// sher snying sngags lugs mi bzhed na// sher snying sngags lugs srid pa ci// gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la// mdo lugs cho ga mi srid na// spyan ras gzigs dang 'jam dbyangs dang*// phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa// mdo las byung ba'i cho ga zhes// bya ba mkhan chen zhi ba 'tshos// mdzad pa'i dgongs pa ci yin grangs// rdo rje slob ma'i dbang tsam zhig /thob pas rab gnas mi rung na// lha bsgoms pa na brtan bzhugs par// rab gnas dngos gzhir bshad pa dang*// 'gal ba'i dogs pa mi 'byung ngam// rdo rje slob dpon ma yin pas// dbang bskur rab gnas mi rung na// bya spyod gnyis kyi dbang bskur tsam// thob pas de dag ji ltar rung*// rgyud sde de dag rang rkang la// rdo rje slob dpon dbang bzhed dam// bzhed na rgyud gzhung gang las gsungs// bya ba'i rgyud du rigs lnga yi// don ma grub na rigs gsum dang*// nor bu dang ni rgyas pa'i rigs// rnam lnga gsungs pa gang gi don// dze ta ri yi tshe dpag med// lha dgu rgyud sde gang gi lugs// rigs lnga ser 'byam mi 'thad na// dmar 'byam 'thad pa dka' ba'i gnas// spyod pa'i rgyud du rigs lnga yi// don grub nas ni padma'i rigs// rgyud gzhung gang gis ston zhes dri// rnal 'byor rgyud kyi kun rdzob kun// lha ru gsungs pa med gyur na// rnal 'byor rgyud dang sems tsam pa'i// grub mtha' bstan pa ji ltar yin// dam pa rigs brgya phye ba'i tshe// kun rdzob lha ru khas len na// rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud las ni// rigs lnga re re'ang rigs chung lnga// de re re la'ang snying po dang*// phyag rgya la sogs bzhir phye nas// rigs brgya yin zhes gsungs pa ci// rgyud sde bzhi yi bsgrub pa yang*// 'khrul par byas pas thag ring na// bya rgyud rnal 'byor rgyud bzhin dang*// bla med rgyud bzhin bsgrub na yang*// dngos grub ring bar 'gyur legs sam// de lta na ni klu sgrub dang*// 'phags ma dpal mos mdzad de ci// theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pas// bya rgyud cho ga ji ltar bya// phyi rol yul chen so bdun zhes// bya ba rgyud gzhung gang nas bshad// 'dzam gling tsam po yul chen du// khas len nus na rang la yang*// mi 'dod pa dag mi 'byung ngam// ma pham ma dros min gyur na// gaṅgā de nyid min par 'gyur// zhes pa'i lan kyang 'don dgos so// mngon pa nas gsungs gangs can de// ti si min par phyogs snga mas// khas blangs shambha la yi ni// gangs can ti sir ma smras pas// rtsod lan 'brel pa gang yin brtag

/rang gi lugs la mngon pa nas// gsungs pa'i gangs can rgyud sde las// bshad pa'i gangs can der bzhed dam// gzhan yang bde mchog kyai rdor las// gsungs pa'i gangs can gang yin la// sham bha la yi gangs can du// nges par zhal gyis bzhes nus sam// de nas kla klo'i rdzu 'phrul gyis// sham bha la ru dmag 'dren pa'i// bshad pa gsal po gang na bzhugs// rigs ldan drag po zhes bya ba// phyag rdor sprul par gang du bshad// ji ltar 'dud pa'i bye brag gi /zhes sogs dgra bcom rang rgyal gyis// stong nyid rtogs pa'i sgrub byed du// drangs nas mdo sde rgyan gyi lung*// sems tsam gzhung du ji ltar 'gyur// yi dam bsgom pa dkrongs bskyed kyi// sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ma 'phrod na// shin tu zab pa bcos min gyis// bskyed pa rim pa de ci zhig /rim pa lnga bar 'od gsal dang*// zung 'jug ces bya chos sku dang*// sgyu ma'i sku la bshad pas na// 'od gsal 'bras bu'i mthar thug tu// khas blangs pa la 'gal ci yod// byang chub bar du blangs pa yis// so sor thar pa 'jig 'gyur na// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// tshul khrims kyis ni bslab pa dang*// zhes sogs zer ba ji ltar yin// phag mo'i byin brlabs mar pa la// med pa'i rgyu mtshan gsal po ci// mar pa rigs lnga gdan rdzogs kyi// thog mar phag mo'i byin brlabs ni// nges par byed ces zer ba thos// rje btsun mi la man chad la// chos drug yod dam med pa ni// gzhung gi dgongs pa gang yin dri// yod na nā ro'i brgyud pa ni// 'dod la 'gal ba ci zhig yod// med na chos drug lugs gsum po// gsan tshul ji ltar yin pa dri// bde mchog snyan rgyud ces bya ba// brdzun ma'i chos su mkhas rnams bzhed// phyag rgya chen mo bsgom bzhin du// nā ro'i brgyud pa 'ded pa la// 'gal ba ci zhig yod pa dri// bcom ldan gyi ni bshad pa la// bzhi bcom drug ldan mi dgos na// gang rung re res chog gam ci// de lta na ni dgra bcom dang*// legs ldan sogs la'ang mi thal lam// phyag rgya chen po'i sgra don la// lag pa'i sgra don 'khrul 'gyur na// rtag pa gnyis par brda dang ni// brda'i lan la phyag rgya zhes// gsungs pa'i dgongs pa gang yin btsal// rdo rje 'byung bar lha rnams kyi// lag pa'i rnam 'gyur mi 'dra la// phyag rgya chen por bshad de ci// ti lo ti lor mi rung na// i'i yi ge e zhes pa// kā la pa las gsungs de ci// nā ro zhes bya bram ze yi// bye brag yin mod ta zhes pa// zhe sa'i tshig tu sbyar min nam// ko'u shi ka'i mdo zhes pa// brdzun ma de yi mtshan gzhi dri// mu stegs byed kyi rgyud yin pas// lung du bya bar mi rung na// dbyangs char rgyud dang sman dpyad dang*// kā la pa dang daṇḍi yi// tshig rgyan gzhung dang 'chi med kyi// bang mdzod la sogs mkhas rnams la// grags pa'i lung dag 'dor dgos sam// ma rig ces sogs rgyud bla yi// lung de gang na yod pa dri// bshad dang gang zhig ces pa'i bar// yod na rje btsun nyid kyis ni// de ltar yid ches man chad kyi// tshig bshad drang nges mdzad de ci// bka' bsdu gsum pa'i tha snyad ni// gzhung lugs gang nas 'byung ba dri// lha chen chos log sun 'byin pa// bsdu ba gsum par gang nas bshad// nyi ma'i dngos grub ces pa yi// gtam rgyud 'di yang gang nas 'byung*// dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa dang*// mnga' bdag ye shes 'od kyi bar// chos log du ma 'phel de gang*// rin chen bzang po'i bstan bcos na// sbyor sgrol bkag pa tsam zhig ni// ma gtogs chos log thams cad ni// nub par mdzad pa'i gzhung mi snang*// pho brang zhi ba 'od dang ni// mgos kyi sngags log sun 'byin na// rang la gnod pa 'ga' yang snang*// dpa' bo khyod kyi bstan pa ni// zhes sogs 'di ni su la bstod// rang re'i ston pa thugs rje can// nyid kyi bstod pa yin lags sam// rig 'dzin sdom pa'i skabs zhes pa'i// le'u'i mtshan yang mi 'byung ci// de ltar legs par dris pa'i don// gzhung lugs 'di la dad pa dang*// rnam dpyad thos pa mang ldan cing*// lce bde don gsal smra mkhas pa// kha zegs bsdus pa'i cal col gyis// mkhas pa'i bstan bcos chud gsan par// mthong nas legs par dris pa yin// 'di lan ji bzhin mi mkhyen na// slar yang 'dri bo nyid la dris// de nas legs par bshad pa yin// dga' ston phyogs bcur 'phel bar 'gyur// gang dag gzhung don rtogs sla zhes// btang snyoms 'jog pa de dag gis// 'di don shes pa ma mthong nas// dka' gnas 'ga' zhig dris pa yin// dri ba dang ni sun 'byin gyi// gnas rnams legs par mi shes pa'i// mkhas 'dod mun sprul phreng ba can// de dag tshig ler byas 'di yis// bstan bcos 'di ni bkag go zhes// smra na rang gi skyon yin te// gang dag mkhas pa ngo mtshar can// gzhung lugs gang dang gang 'chad tshe// de dang de yi dka' ba'i gnas// ma lus legs par blangs nas su// 'chad cing dri ba'i tshul gyis ni// gzhan la 'chad cing rtsom pa yin// zhes rje btsun dgyes pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mnga' ris smad kyi sa'i thig le thub bstan dar rgyas gling gi gtsug lag khang chen po nas/
